claims.paraphrase: Nitrobenzene-grown JS45 deaminase was purified by sequential anion exchange, copper chelate, gel filtration and hydrophobic steps.
Purified deaminase has16.6kDa subunits and apparent100kDa native mass; six identical subunits are inferred. These measurements are not4OT measurements.
Crude extracts accelerate hydroxymuconate tautomerization (about7min to2min half-life at0.1mg/ml), whereas purified deaminase does not.
Spontaneous conversion is measured in25mM phosphate pH8.0,0.15MNaCl. It is distinct from1971 conditions; no universal half-life is inferred.
Rapid spectra support direct keto product rather than a detectable hydroxymuconate intermediate. The imine/proton-donor mechanism is an inference, not direct intermediate isolation.
Tautomerase activity in JS45 extract need not participate in its aminophenol route; component presence does not prove catechol pathway execution.
Metal effects, EDTA insensitivity and histidine-reagent inhibition describe the deaminase. Do not attach them to4OT.

limits: Historical4-oxalocrotonate is defined as2oxohex3enedioate here, without modernE/Z structural assignment.
Fullsequence and exact native current protein correspondence not established by Nterminal similarity alone.
